intro.title: Arrays & Iterators
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple program that manages a list of your favorite movies. You will learn how to create and manipulate arrays, which are used to store collections of data in JavaScript. The core concepts include using array methods like push, pop, and forEach to add, remove, and loop through items. By the end, you'll understand how to use iterators to process each element in an array efficiently.
intro.usecase: Arrays and iterators are fundamental to building dynamic user interfaces in modern web applications. You'll use them to render lists of data like product catalogs in e-commerce sites, display user notifications in social media feeds, or populate dropdown menus in forms. When building dashboards that show analytics charts or tables, arrays store the data points while iterators transform and display them. Every time you filter search results, sort a table, or paginate content, you're working with arrays and their iteration methods.
